{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
ad = '2025-10-20'

# Exact raw name check
vals = sorted(df['instance_family'].unique())
print([v for v in vals if v.startswith('GW')])
print(repr(df[df['instance_family'].str.startswith('GW')]['instance_family'].unique()))

# any other rows with expiration_date == anomaly date?
print(df[df['expiration_date']==ad]['instance_family'].unique())

# confirm GWymgjl2rF rows: sum on anomaly day and before/after
sub = df[df['instance_family']=='GWymgjl2rF']
print("price before:", sub[sub['date']<ad]['price'].unique(),
      "| price on/after:", sub[sub['date']>=ad]['price'].unique())
print("daily cost before (avg):", sub[sub['date']<ad]['unblended_cost'].mean().round(2),
      "| on 10-20:", sub[sub['date']==ad]['unblended_cost'].sum(),
      "| after (avg):", sub[sub['date']>ad]['unblended_cost'].mean().round(2))

# share of the day-over-day and seasonal anomaly explained
daily = df.groupby('date')['unblended_cost'].sum()
print("account total 10-19:", daily[ad].__class__, daily.get('2025-10-19'), "10-20:", daily.get(ad))
"}
